# Theme

Design tokens and base type. Every other component expects a `Theme` above it. The tokens themselves are in `Theme.module.css`; [docs/theming.md](../../docs/theming.md) lists them.

## `Theme.tsx`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `usePortalTarget` | Where overlays such as `Modal` render, so they keep the theme's tokens. Falls back to `document.body`. |
| `Theme` | Sets the design tokens and base type for everything inside it. Every other component expects a Theme above it. |
| `Surface` | A grey area. Fields, borders and helper text inside it switch to the slightly darker scheme the order summary uses. |
| `subduedScheme` | Class that switches an element's contents to the grey-surface scheme, for components that own their element. |
